title: 第17章 赛后风波第18章 未来
content_zh:
第十七章赛后风波
巴西国内有无数的少年天才，对世界足坛来说，那里就是一个时时刻刻都闪烁着金光的巨大宝库，几乎随随便便在街上拉住一个少年，都拥有着高超的球技。
但是对欧洲的主流联赛，尤其是五大联赛来说，那种所谓的天才也未免太多了些，他们会将注意力投向那片土地，但是也只会投向那些已经在巴西国内证明了自己的球员。
这份名单当中很显然并不包括迪甘，如果不是因为卡卡的话，谁会认识那个小吊丝！
初来乍道，一鸣惊人！
如今用在迪甘的身上一点儿都不为过，意甲联赛首秀，三个进球，一个助攻，即使是卡卡当初刚到米兰的时候，都不曾有过这样精彩的表演。
用一战成名来形容迪甘的神奇经历，或许会更加贴切一些，如果这个经历放在别人身上的话，是绝对值得大书特书的，那些媒体就喜欢干这事儿，哪怕之前他们将迪甘形容成莱特家的耻辱，卡卡人生唯一的污点，但是有了这场比赛，让他们将拉出来的便便再吃回去，他们不会有任何心理负担！
这里有一个但是！
这场比赛很显然有更加吸引人眼球的东西，那个东西比迪甘的完美首演，更能刺激报纸的销量，以及电视节目的收视率。
一个球员被本方的球迷嘘，这在足球场上并不少见，站在球迷的立场，如果本方的球员，表现糟糕的话，他们是绝对零容忍的，当初埃芬博格就曾有过被上前拜仁球迷集体竖中指的光辉记录。
但是迪甘连草皮都被上，他甚至都还没有为亚特兰大效力一秒钟，就几乎成了贝尔加莫最不受欢迎的球员。
如果不考虑这场比赛的过程，单单看迪甘交出的这份成绩单的话，剧本应该是这样的，大发神威的迪甘在场上连进三球，完成了帽子戏法，又助攻锋线搭档帕齐尼攻入一球，球员和球迷化干戈为玉帛，迪甘继而征服整座蓝色意大利球场。
一个非常经典的吊丝逆袭的故事，说不定欧足联还会把迪甘作为立志代表，大加宣传，谁都知道欧足联最喜欢干的就是这事儿。
但偏偏迪甘是个不按常理出牌的人，三个进球，先是对着球迷一通大骂，紧接着示威，最后扇耳光，戏路全被改动了，迪甘一下子从立志小吊丝变身成了比克大魔王。
还有什么比这个更精彩的，尽管曼多利尼早就有心理准备，可是当他出现在新闻发布会现场的时候，还是被蜂拥而至的记者们晃瞎了眼。
“曼多利尼教练，请问你是怎么看待迪甘和球迷之间矛盾的！”
“曼多利尼教练，请问亚特兰大会不会对迪甘进行内部禁赛，来安抚球迷！”
“曼多里尼教练，请你评价一下迪甘对待球迷的粗暴.行为！”
粗暴.行为！
怎么看待！

内部禁赛！
曼多利尼真是气大了，这可是他从事教练工作以来的第一场比赛，首秀就取得了开门红，这是多大的运道，不对！应该是能力！
那些该死的记者不上来吹捧几句，说说穆里尼奥二代降世临凡，怎么偏偏对准了他最不想面对的问题。
等着那帮记者稍稍安静下来之后，曼多利尼才唬着一张脸，道：“你们应该将注意力集中在这场比赛上，而不是某个球员的花边新闻，我并不想评价迪甘的行为，如果你们非要问的话，我只能说，我对今天到场的亚特兰大球迷非常失望，他们不能凭借一些猜测就否定一名球员的实力，迪甘是我亲自引进的，我相信他的实力，对他今天在球场上的表现，我一点儿都不意外，他原本应该享受欢呼，享受胜利，但是今天有些人的表现伤了他的心，所以他才做了一些过激的反映，这是情有可原的，毕竟他才十九岁！好了！既然你们都对这场比赛不感兴趣，那么我就去和我的球员们庆祝胜利了！”
曼多利尼也是个性格男，说完站起身来就走，留下那群记者面面相觑，不过追逐新闻，是他们这群苍蝇的天性，哪怕是一滩屎，只要臭的味道不一样，他们也要上去.舔两口。
曼多利尼不说话，那干脆就去找正主。
刚回到更衣室，球员们已经洗过澡，正在换衣服了，曼多利尼皱着没有，观察了一阵，道：“罗德在什么地方！？”
帕齐尼正好把上衣穿上，随口道：“罗德！他已经走了！”
曼多利尼闻言，顿时脸色一变，心里暗骂了一声：“糟糕！那个蠢货！”
曼多利尼嘴里的蠢货，现在已经到了停车场，刚准备开车门，就被好像卡卡西一样突然冒出来的大群记者吓了一跳，差点儿挥拳自卫。
见对方是记者，迪甘本来还挺高兴，毕竟出名是件好事，放弃美食，放弃清闲，拼死拼活训练，比赛为的是什么，还不就是两个字，钱，名！
可是当那些记者向他发问之后，迪甘的脸色立刻就变了，这些混蛋居然集体日盲，没看见他今天精彩的表演，却只关心他和球迷的矛盾，是可忍孰不可忍。
“你们觉得我做错了吗？见鬼！只有白痴才会有这样的疑问，难道你被人打了，还要对打你的人笑脸相迎吗？我会怎么做？说你们是白痴看来都抬举了你们，我的做法你们不是都看的很清楚吗？谁打我的脸，我就依样打回去，知道他们把脑袋缩回去！球迷！？我不认为那些家伙是亚特兰大的球迷，因为我从来都没见过有球迷会不帮着我们呐喊助威，反而去帮着外人的，如果他们是亚特兰大最坚定的球迷，那我可真的要为亚特兰大感到悲哀了，那些蛆虫根本就没资格进入蓝色意大利球场！”
迪甘说完，推开那些围着他的记者，就上了车，可是对方却不肯罢休，虽然被迪甘讥讽为白痴，但是他们很乐意当选这个称呼，有这个一个大嘴巴喷手绝对是记者的福音。
迪甘见那些记者还围着他的车，不让他离开，也不管那么多直接倒车，然后作势就要前冲。
记者们看在眼里，立刻察觉出来这小子绝对不是说笑的，连滚带爬的闪到一边，眼看着迪甘的车从他们的身边呼啸而过，顺便还喷了他们一脸黑烟。
“该死！那小子真是个疯子，绝对的疯子！”
“我绝对不让他好过，我发誓！”
迪甘这个初出茅庐的小菜鸟一天的时间同时把球迷和媒体记者这两大势力给狠狠的得罪了，不过迪甘会在乎吗？
很显然那小子就是缺根弦。

果然到了第二天，几乎整个意大利的专业体育报纸，电视节目都出现了迪甘的身影，当然不是什么光辉灿烂的形象，在这些媒体的口中，笔下，迪甘就是一个彻头彻尾的恶魔，疯子，一个那惹是生非当人生信条的混蛋，卡萨诺和他相比，简直纯洁的好像天使一样，就差张开翅膀守护芸芸众生了。
本来比赛的第二天，球队是要放假的，迪甘正做着美梦，却被一阵急促的电话铃声给吵醒了。
“喂！我是罗德里格.伊泽森~~~~~~~~”
“我知道你是谁！”
是博斯克！
“有事吗？今天球队放假，我正在休息！如果没事的话，就等我睡醒了你再打过来！”对这一世的父亲，迪甘一向都很有意见。
“罗德里格！我想你应该为报纸上的事情像我解释一下！”博斯克的语气听上去似乎火气很大。
“报纸？什么报纸！？”
迪甘满心的疑惑，虽然有些不耐烦，但还是台扇耳光的镜头。
“真酷！”
迪甘想着就说了出来，电话另一边的博斯克险些被气的大小便失禁。
紧接着画面一转，出现了两个衣冠楚楚的北朝鲜政府官员模样的人，正在侃侃而谈，越听迪甘的脸色就越是阴沉。
“很显然这个巴西小子缺乏对球迷最基本的尊重，要知道一个成功的俱乐部生存下去的关键就是球迷，没有球迷的支持，任何球队最终都难逃衰落的命运！”
“迪甘的做法很显然没经过大脑思考，他就像是个无脊椎卵生软体动物一样，完全是身体指挥大脑，不！他根本就没有大脑。”
“我不知道他为什么这么做，或许他因为一场比赛的精彩表现而飘飘然了，看看他得意的样子，难道他不知道能完成帽子戏法完全是运气好的缘故吗？就好像第二个球，功劳应该是德米的，要不是他的远射正好砸在他的脸上，他能完成帽子戏法！”
“当初坎通纳就是因为飞踹水晶宫的球迷，最终被禁赛了八个月，我觉得对迪甘的处罚应该更重，他的行为实在是不利于构建和谐球场！”
这两个混蛋究竟是从哪来的，还和谐球场，他们是不是去天朝进修过？
“都看到了吗？”
“当然！画面很清楚！”迪甘所答非所问，他不喜欢博斯克质问的语气。
果然，博斯克的怒火立刻喷张：“难道你不想对我解释一下吗？为什么要做那么愚蠢的事，现在就连里卡多都受到了影响。”

又是卡卡！
他们的心里就只有卡卡！
“我不觉得我该对你解释什么，如果你觉得我做错了，我也不想解释，我的事情我会负责，如果你真的想要关心一下的话，最好还是把你的关心都放在卡卡的身上，而不是对着我指手画脚！”
迪甘说完，就挂断了电话。
妈的！老子就是要和全世界为敌，不疯魔不成活！
突然手机又是一阵响动，迪甘一看是一条短信，
content_en:
Chapter 17 Post-match turmoil
There are countless young geniuses in Brazil. To the world of football, it is a huge treasure house that is always shining with golden light. Almost any teenager you pick up on the street will have superb football skills.
But for the mainstream leagues in Europe, especially the five major leagues, there are too many so-called talents. They will focus on that land, but they will only focus on those players who have proven themselves in Brazil.
This list obviously does not include Deegan. If it were not for Kaka, who would know that little hanging silk!
When I first came here, I was an instant success!
Now it is not an exaggeration to apply it to Deegan. In his Serie A debut, he scored three goals and one assist. Even Kaká had never had such a wonderful performance when he first arrived in Milan.
It may be more appropriate to describe Deegan's magical experience with "Fight to Fame". If this experience is applied to others, it is definitely worth writing about. Those media like to do this, even if they previously described Deegan as the shame of the Wright family and the only stain in Kaka's life, but with this game, they will eat back the poop they pulled out, and they will not have any psychological burden!
Here is a BUT!
There is obviously something more eye-catching about this game, something that can stimulate newspaper sales and TV ratings more than Deegan's perfect debut.
It is not uncommon for a player to be booed by his own fans. This is not uncommon on the football field. From the fans' point of view, if their own players perform poorly, they will have absolutely zero tolerance. Effenberg had a glorious record of being collectively given the middle finger by Bayern fans who approached him.
But Deegan was not even on the turf, and he had not even played for Atalanta for a second and was almost the most disliked player in Bergamo.
If you ignore the process of this game and just look at the transcript handed over by Deegan, the script should be like this. The powerful Deegan scored three goals in a row on the court, completing a hat trick, and assisted his strike partner Pazzini to score a goal. The players and fans turned their hostility into friendship, and Deegan went on to conquer the entire blue Italian stadium.
A very classic story of a counterattack. Maybe UEFA will use Deegan as a representative to promote it. Everyone knows that this is what UEFA likes to do the most.
But it turns out that Deegan is a person who doesn't play by the rules. After scoring three goals, he first cursed at the fans, then demonstrated, and finally slapped the fans. The whole drama was changed. Deegan suddenly transformed from a determined little bastard to a big devil named Piccolo.
What could be more exciting than this? Although Mandolini had been mentally prepared for it, when he appeared at the press conference, he was still blinded by the swarming reporters.
"Coach Mandolini, what do you think of the conflict between Deegan and the fans?"
"Coach Mandolini, would Atlanta impose an internal ban on Deegan to appease the fans?"
"Coach Mandolini, please comment on Deegan's rough behavior towards fans!"
Rude behavior!
What do you think?
Internal ban!
Mandolini was really angry. This was his first game since he started coaching, and he got a good start in his first show. What a blessing, no! It should be ability!
Those damn reporters didn't come up to praise a few words and talk about the second generation of Mourinho coming to the world, but they just focused on the problem that he least wanted to face.
After the reporters calmed down for a while, Mandolini said with a bluffing face: "You should focus on this game, not the gossip about a certain player. I don't want to comment on Deegan's behavior. If you insist on asking, I can only say that I am sorry for Art who is here today."The Lanzhou fans are very disappointed. They cannot deny a player's strength based on some speculation. I personally introduced Deegan. I believe in his strength. I am not surprised at all by his performance on the court today. He should have enjoyed the cheers and victory, but some people's performance today hurt his heart, so he made some drastic reactions. This is understandable, after all, he is only nineteen years old! alright! Since none of you are interested in this game, I'm going to celebrate the victory with my players! "
Mandolini was also a man of character. After saying that, he stood up and left, leaving the reporters looking at each other in confusion. However, it was the nature of flies like them to chase news. Even if it was a puddle of feces, as long as the smell was different, they would go up and take a few licks.
If Mandolini doesn't say anything, he might as well go find the real owner.
Just after returning to the locker room, the players had already taken a shower and were changing clothes. Mandolini frowned, observed for a while, and said: "Where is Rod! ? "
Pazzini just put on his shirt and casually said: "Rhode! He's gone! "
When Mandolini heard this, his expression suddenly changed and he cursed in his mind: "Oops! That idiot! "
The idiot in Mandolini's mouth was now in the parking lot. Just as he was about to open the door, he was startled by a large group of reporters who appeared suddenly like Kakashi, and he almost punched himself in self-defense.
Deegan was quite happy to see that the other party was a reporter. After all, being famous is a good thing. He gave up food and leisure and trained hard. What was the purpose of the competition? It was just two words, money and fame!
But when those reporters asked him questions, Deegan's expression immediately changed. These bastards were collectively sunblind and did not see his wonderful performance today, but only cared about the conflict between him and the fans. This is unbearable.
"Do you think I did something wrong? Damn it! Only an idiot would have such a question. Do you have to smile at the person who hit you after being hit? What would I do? Calling you idiots seems to be flattering you. Don't you all see clearly what I am doing? Whoever slaps me in the face, I will hit them back in the same way until they retract their heads! fan! ? I don’t think those guys are Atlanta fans, because I have never seen any fans who don’t cheer for us, but instead help outsiders. If they are the most staunch fans of Atlanta, then I really feel sad for Atlanta. Those maggots are not qualified to enter the blue Italian stadium! "
After Deegan finished speaking, he pushed away the reporters surrounding him and got in the car, but the other party refused to give up. Although Deegan ridiculed them as idiots, they were happy to be elected with this title. Having such a big-mouthed troll is definitely a blessing for reporters.
When Deegan saw that the reporters were still surrounding his car and wouldn't let him leave, he reversed the car regardless of them, and then made a show of moving forward.
The reporters saw this and immediately realized that this kid was definitely not joking. They rolled to the side and watched as Deegan's car whizzed past them and sprayed black smoke in their faces.
"Damn it! That kid is really a madman, an absolute madman! "
"I will never make it easy for him, I swear! "
Deegan, a fledgling rookie, severely offended the two major forces, fans and media reporters, in one day, but does Deegan care?
Obviously that kid is missing a string.
Sure enough, by the next day, Deegan appeared in almost all professional sports newspapers and TV programs in Italy. Of course, it was not a glorious image. In the mouths and writings of these media, Deegan was a complete devil, a madman, a bastard who made trouble his life creed. Compared with him, Cassano was as pure as an angel, and could only spread his wings to protect all living beings.
BenOn the second day after coming to the game, the team was on vacation. Deegan was having a sweet dream, but was awakened by a rapid ringing of the phone.
"Hello! I'm Rodrigo Izeson~~~~~~~~"
"I know who you are!"
It's Bosque!
"Is something okay? The team has a holiday today and I'm taking a rest! If nothing happens, just wait until I wake up and call you again!" Deegan has always had opinions about his father in this life.
"Rodrigo! I think you should explain to me what happened in the newspaper!" Bosque's tone sounded very angry.
"Newspaper? What newspaper!?"
Deegan was full of doubts, and although he was a little impatient, he still shot the slap in the face with the table fan.
"How cool!"
Deegan thought about it and said it. Bosque on the other side of the phone was almost so angry that he became incontinent.
Then the scene changed, and two well-dressed North Korean government officials appeared, talking. The more Deegan listened, the darker his face became.
"Obviously this Brazilian boy lacks the most basic respect for the fans. You must know that the key to the survival of a successful club is the fans. Without the support of fans, no team will eventually escape the fate of decline!"
"Deegan's actions are obviously without thinking through the brain. He is like an invertebrate egg-laying mollusk. His body completely commands the brain. No! He has no brain at all."
"I don't know why he did this. Maybe he was in high spirits because of his wonderful performance in a game. Look at his proud look. Doesn't he know that he was able to complete the hat trick because of good luck? It's like the second goal, the credit should be Demi. If his long shot hadn't hit him in the face, he would have completed the hat trick!"
"Cantona was banned for eight months for kicking Crystal Palace fans. I think Deegan should be punished more severely. His behavior is really not conducive to building a harmonious stadium!"
Where did these two bastards come from and coordinate the stadium? Did they go to China to study?
"Did you see everything?"
"Of course! The picture is very clear!" Deegan's answer was not what was asked. He didn't like the tone of Bosque's questioning.
Sure enough, Bosque's anger immediately burst out: "Don't you want to explain to me? Why did you do such a stupid thing? Now even Ricardo is affected."
It’s Kaka again!
They only have Kaka in their hearts!
"I don't think I should explain anything to you. If you think I did something wrong, I don't want to explain. I will be responsible for my affairs. If you really want to care, it's better to put all your care on Kaka instead of pointing fingers at me!"
After Deegan finished speaking, he hung up the phone.
Oh shit! I just want to be the enemy of the whole world. I can't live without going crazy!
Suddenly, the phone rang again. Deegan saw that it was a text message.
